chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibrahim ibn Mihzam, from Talha ibn Zayd, from the one who raised it, said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'When one of you is brought basil, let him smell it and place it upon his eyes, for it is from Paradise, and when one of you is brought it, let him not reject it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended etiquette for receiving and using basil according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) emphasis on appreciating the sensory blessings of creation, specifically identifying basil as a fragrant plant originating from Paradise. It underscores the Shia tradition of finding spiritual and physical comfort in natural gifts, encouraging believers to accept them with gratitude rather than rejecting them out of modesty or habit.
